content.text:
I proposed replacement for 2 of your 9 laptops, not all of them. Only those 2 have the evidence the replacement policy needs: findings in two hardware areas, or constant memory pressure on hardware that can't be upgraded. The budget approval doesn't change this, so I didn't flag the other 7.

**Evidence**
- **Laptops found:** 9 [1LYSSFD074BB/2026-06-12, 7VP16KHV88LM/2026-06-12, 8NM23J95R5I6/2026-06-12, 9MXJVZ1I0DKA/2026-06-12, DSYPSES7SKBB/2026-06-12, M4XVHUV1MEPZ/2026-06-12, MT7PJB7N5LRE/2026-06-12, Q3VUITEGQ400/2026-06-12, XSU9UUDGU6AC/2026-06-12].
- **8NM23J95R5I6 (ThinkPad X1 Carbon, emp-acme-1005)** – qualifies on disk and battery:
  - Disk is 2.6% free, below the 10% low-disk threshold, and will be full in about 5 days at the current rate [disk_low/8NM23J95R5I6, disk_trend/8NM23J95R5I6].
  - Battery has 1157 cycles (rated for 1000) and says "Service Recommended" [battery_eol/8NM23J95R5I6].
- **M4XVHUV1MEPZ (Dell XPS 15, emp-acme-1002)** – qualifies on memory and battery:
  - Memory use was at or above 80% in 30 of 30 snapshots on 16 GB [ram_pressure/M4XVHUV1MEPZ].
  - Battery has 948 cycles and says "Service Recommended" [battery_eol/M4XVHUV1MEPZ].
- **MT7PJB7N5LRE** – has a disk problem only: 2.0% free, about 10 days until full [disk_low/MT7PJB7N5LRE, disk_trend/MT7PJB7N5LRE]. Clearing space or a storage upgrade fits better than replacement.
- **7VP16KHV88LM** – has a battery problem only: 1049 cycles, "Service Recommended" [battery_eol/7VP16KHV88LM]. A new battery fits better than replacement.
- **1LYSSFD074BB, 9MXJVZ1I0DKA, DSYPSES7SKBB, Q3VUITEGQ400, XSU9UUDGU6AC** – no disk, memory or battery findings. Nothing in the data supports replacing them.

**Proposed actions (awaiting approval)**

| Proposal | Action | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| P-ef8ec252 | Flag 8NM23J95R5I6 for replacement | Disk and battery |
| P-159cc47c | Flag M4XVHUV1MEPZ for replacement | Memory and battery |

Nothing happens until a human approves these.

**Caveats**
- Thresholds used:
  - **Low disk:** under 10% free.
  - **Memory pressure:** at least 80% used in at least 75% of snapshots.
  - **Battery end-of-life:** compared with a 1000-cycle rating; a warning starts at 90% of it.
- MT7PJB7N5LRE has no battery data in its latest snapshot. That's a gap in data collection, not proof the battery is fine.
- If you want to replace laptops for other reasons, like a planned refresh or age, the telemetry can't support that. It would have to go through your normal purchasing process.
- I can propose a disk cleanup ticket for MT7PJB7N5LRE and a battery replacement for 7VP16KHV88LM if you'd like.
